narrative.text: I’ll verify the DM scope-ordering failure, add regressions and show them failing on `e616fe86`, then make a new fix commit. I’ll rerun the build, both full test suites, and the two review probes.The failure is reproduced: on `e616fe86`, missing `chat:write` or `im:read` yields the malformed-text refusal; missing `im:write` already behaves correctly. The fix now checks all three scopes before text validation or DM opening, while retaining the fresh post-open access and exact-peer checks. All three new regressions pass.The fix commit passes the build and both full suites: Node 22 has 768 passes, 25 skips, and no failures; Node 24 passes all 793 tests. The adversarial probe passes all four tests. The parent-comparison probe now shows the same scope-refusal text as the fork parent, with zero Slack calls on the fixed branch.
